title: 'One Cut of the Dead' - question about the ending

commenti.body:
Yeah the tv broadcast part is also fictional. The movie as a whole is either a production done by a local amateur theater group or a bunch of film students, I've alternatively heard both stories. Either way it was extremely low budget crowd funded.

Fun Story: this movie was such an important unexpected massive hit in Japan that there was a rush to get it streaming in N America. The first time I saw it the makers had physically mailed a screener dvd w english subtitles to Amazon Prime and the random employee who received the package had never heard of it, so they just ripped and uploaded it and it was just sitting there streaming for a few days before someone caught the mistake.
